Great Lecture, do not need the book at all. Test are straight from what she says so you just have to attend class and take good notes. To study for the exam just read over your notes like 2 times.

Lectures are interesting, worth going to even though they're not mandatory. Take good notes and pay attention because tests are extremely tough if you don't know your stuff including little details. Go to lecture and study for the tests. She is a good professor and is super prepared for every lecture, but the tests are hard and they are the only grades. Also, if you buy some cheap lecture notes off of luvo that will help a lot for studying.

Awesome lectures. She gives you all the information you need if you just write down everything she says. Only three tests all weighted differently... no attendance, assignments or extra credit. Very nice woman. I would take her again. Ended up with an A in the class.

I would definitely take this professor again! She is passionate about what she teaches and uses multiple examples to explain things. GO TO CLASS! she's an awesome lecturer, just study how she says and you'll do well

All grades come from the tests. Most test content came from her lectures. Isn't very specific when it comes to the test reviews. Her tests are hard, I suggest reading the book and just knowing everything basically.

Must attend lectures; tests are 90% covered by her lecture material. Read the book and take good notes. Not easy, but if you study it isn't challenging. She really makes the lectures interesting too; she is easy to listen to and very likable.

Everyone take her!

Dr. Lipsmeyer was great! Her lectures were crystal clear and enjoyable to listen to. Make sure you're in class! Most of the test material is from lectures. No final which was so great! This is a class you want to take.

Getting the textbook helps a little but 90% of the test is from her lectures so attendance is a must. First test is hardest but the 2nd and 3rd aren't bad at all! I recommend her!

Three tests no final. The tests are weighted differently, the first one is 25%, second is 35% and the third is 40%. The lectures are super important and cover all the material, and are more helpful than the book. The lectures are long, but interesting. She is a loud speaker, and very clear. Great prof.
Very knowledgeable. Tests are fair but you have to take notes. Attendance isn't graded but is necessary to pass. Got an 88 on exam 1 and a 100 on exam 2. Looking to get an A on exam 3

Dr. Lipsmeyer is great! She is very straightforward with her lectures so as long as you take good notes and study for the test an A or B should be no problem. There are three tests, no quizzes or assignments and no final so your grade comes from those three tests. I highly recommend her!
Very interesting lectures and she is very clear with the information. I never opened the textbook and made a B with some effort A is not far off. Only 3 test NO FINAL!

Great Prof!! I hated polisci before, but she made it very interesting. Her tests are lecture based, so if you attend class and take good notes, you are certain to make a good grade. Lipsmeyer is a great lecturer. She truly is passionate about what she teaches and makes the information interesting. He tests aren't that bad either. I made an 86 on the first exam, a 96 on the second, and I'm expecting to make a high A on the third exam. NO FINAL!!!!!

Very clear and well-organized! Knows her material. Take notes, because test will be lecture + some reading.  Going through book helps review/check notes if you missed something in class. Ok Proff. She is very structured and organized. her tests reflect her lecture and the book is secondary, but not at all nesassary. doest post anything online so even though she doest take attendance, if you want any hope of a good grade, dont miss the lectures.

Pretty easy, just take notes and read the book and the tests are cake.

AWESOME PROFESSOR!!!! Really knows her stuff.
